snippet.title: Pigface | Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Play as Exit, a ruthless woman with a dark past who’s finally about to pay the price for her actions. Beaten, bloody, and trapped in an empty warehouse, you wake to find a bomb implanted at the base of your skull. A mysterious voice on the phone gives you no choice: do the jobs, or die.

Become their unwilling gun-for-hire, complete missions to earn money, and upgrade your arsenal with gear from the Black Market. Unlock a variety of masks, each offering unique advantages to tailor your playstyle. Whether you prefer heavy gunfire, brutal melee, deadly traps, or silent infiltration. There’s only one rule: Get The Job Done.

Wishlist PIGFACE: https://dreadxp.games/PIGFACE_

Follow the Developer: https://x.com/titolovesyou

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/JTPfXdSFXq
